changesets.summary: Add subscription guards and wallet-following streams
changesets.details: `Subscription` owns a listener closure and its unsubscribe function and detaches on drop, replacing the `on_register` / `on_unregister` API whose closure and dispose handle could drift apart into a leaked listener or a silently dead one. `BrowserWallet::account_changes` streams the wallet's account changes through `standard:events` so apps stop going stale when the user switches accounts inside the wallet, `BrowserWallet::on_change_with` exposes the raw change notifications, and `watch_wallets` streams the page's wallet registry including late registrations. The leptos example follows account changes through the stream.

## [0.7.4](https://github.com/pina-rs/wallet_standard/releases/tag/v0.7.4) (2026-10-26)

Grouped release for `core`.

### Features

- **Add subscription guards and wallet-following streams.** `Subscription` owns a listener closure and its unsubscribe function and detaches on drop, replacing the `on_register` / `on_unregister` API whose closure and dispose handle could drift apart into a leaked listener or a silently dead one. `BrowserWallet::account_changes` streams the wallet's account changes through `standard:events` so apps stop going stale when the user switches accounts inside the wallet, `BrowserWallet::on_change_with` exposes the raw change notifications, and `watch_wallets` streams the page's wallet registry including late registrations. The leptos example follows account changes through the stream.
  _Packages:_ 🟠 _wallet_standard_browser_
  _Owner:_ [@ifiokjr](https://github.com/ifiokjr) · _Review:_ [PR #81](https://github.com/pina-rs/wallet_standard/pull/81)
